---
name: Documentation problem
about: Something in the docs is wrong, unclear, outdated, or broken
title: ''
labels: documentation
assignees: ''
---

**Which page?**
Paste the URL, e.g. https://docs.helixid.dev/concepts/delegation

**What's wrong?**
Pick whichever applies and describe it:

- [ ] Factually incorrect — describes behaviour the code does not have
- [ ] Out of date — was true, no longer is
- [ ] Code sample doesn't work
- [ ] Unclear or hard to follow
- [ ] Broken link or missing image
- [ ] Typo / grammar
- [ ] Something is missing entirely

**What does it say now?**
Quote the passage, if it's a specific one.

**What should it say?**
Even a rough suggestion helps. If you know what the code actually does, say how you
know — a file, a package version, or something you ran.

**Anything else**
Screenshots, browser, or device if it's a rendering problem.
